operating_point.rule: flag when mahalanobis distance exceeds train_quantiles.q0.99
operating_point.note: replaces the hand-set 0.5 sigmoid(failure_logit) veto as the out-of-distribution test. The failure head answers 'will this solve fail', which is a different question and is measurably miscalibrated (ECE ~0.48); this answers 'is this part unlike anything I was trained on'.
